rules.title: Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code
rules.requirement: Jersey City administers and enforces a rent control ordinance that regulates rent in covered buildings, including landlord applications for rent increases (capital improvement, hardship) and tenant petitions over illegal rent. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt.
rules.citation: Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code
rules.status_basis: Ordinance is in the municipal code and is currently administered by the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations.

exempt_if.text: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control

coverage.summary: Applies to rental properties with five or more units.
coverage.exemptions_summary: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt; other exemptions may be requested through a Rent Control Exemption Request.

rules.quoted_span: (Please Note: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control)
